# Df cost of delay vs noise

`customer_support.df.escalation_management.df_cost_of_delay_vs_noise` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Cost of Delay versus Cost of Noise — the only real trade in the decision to escalate. Delay is paid by this customer; noise is paid by every future escalation from this agent.

Names both sides of a trade that is usually argued with only one side visible. It also makes explicit that the cost of over-escalating is real, which is what stops the corrective advice to escalate earlier from degrading into escalating everything.
